proposal.family: swing-extreme absorption via divergent close-location pressure (daily failed-breakout spring/upthrust class)
proposal.mechanism_statement: Stop-loss and breakout-entry orders clustered beyond a recent swing extreme are price-INELASTIC: when price prints a fresh K-bar extreme, those orders must execute at the extreme, and the flow they generate is absorbed by patient, price-elastic participants (dealers warehousing inventory, real-money ladder buyers, slow CTA confirmation lags) who work the fill over subsequent days. The daily-bar fingerprint of an extreme produced by forced stop execution rather than conviction flow is a DIVERGENCE between two price-only observables on the same leg: the bar makes a fresh K-bar extreme while the accumulated close-location pressure (where each day's close sits inside its own range, summed) is moving the OPPOSITE way. Post-absorption, the absent follow-through supply/demand produces multi-day drift back through the broken level. The tradable state requires the two inputs to DISAGREE; an extreme with confirming pressure is the complement class and must earn nothing if the mechanism is real.
who_is_forced_or_slow: FORCED: stop-loss orders and stop-entry breakout orders parked beyond the visible K-bar extreme - inelastic, must execute at the extreme print
SLOW: CTA/trend systems with confirmation lags that add only after pressure confirms (so unconfirmed extremes are pre-CTA, and the drift is the period before slow money piles in)
SLOW: real-money hedgers/ladder orders worked over days rather than crossed at market
proposal.observable: Per leg, per completed daily bar t (16:00-NY stamp, TD 1day OHLC): CLV_t = ((C_t - L_t) - (H_t - C_t)) / (H_t - L_t) in [-1, +1] (CLV undefined/0 if H_t == L_t); pressure P_t = sum of CLV over trailing 20 completed bars; BULLISH absorption state at t: C_t == rolling-min(C,20) (fresh 20-bar extreme) AND P_t > P_{t-5} (pressure slope positive over 5 bars); BEARISH absorption state: symmetric (fresh 20-bar high AND P_t < P_{t-5}). Position s_t = -1 on bullish state, +1 on bearish state (toward absorption direction), else 0. All features computed from completed bars <= t only.
when_it_must_fail: If CONFIRMED extremes (fresh 20-bar extreme WITH confirming 5-bar pressure slope in the same direction) earn as much or more than the absorption anchor, the divergence carries no information - mandated complement control, falsification-by-control kill
If post-absorption drift does not clear the 1.5 bps cost floor at STRESS_TIER_2.0 (PRIMARY), the family is economically dead regardless of gross behavior
If co-firing across the 5 legs is a common-USD-factor artifact (USD-drift gate fail), the measured effect is USD beta in new words - dead
If post-2008 range quantization/spread widening destroys CLV informativeness, late-sample folds must show it honestly (fold positivity gate)
